beats.text: 143 out of 186 countries and territories have at least 50 percent internet usage.
Yellow areas show 50 percent or more usage, while dark blue areas are below that.
South Sudan has the world's lowest usage at 7 percent.
Kuwait reaches 100 percent, while Nigeria sits at 41 percent.
The metric counts individuals who have used the internet from any location in the last 3 months.
Among these countries, India is at 70 percent and the USA is at 95 percent.
So where does your country rank?
